info.name: Premier League Simulation API
info.description:
REST API for the Premier League match simulator.

The base URL is the `{{base_url}}` collection variable, defaulting to `http://localhost:8080`. To hit the live deployment, edit the variable to `https://pl-sim.onrender.com` (note: the free Render tier sleeps after inactivity, so the first request may take ~50s while the instance wakes).

Typical flow: GET current season -> POST next-week (or play-all) -> GET standings -> GET predictions (available once 4 weeks are played) -> PATCH a match score -> POST reset.

request.description: Liveness probe used by Render. Returns 200 with `{"status":"ok"}`.
Returns the active season (id, name, current_week, total_weeks, created_at). 404 `NO_CURRENT_SEASON` if none exists.
Returns `{"teams":[...]}` including each team's attack_strength, defense_strength, and home_advantage (the parameters that drive the simulator).
Returns `{"rows":[...]}` — the league table computed on read from the played matches. Sorted by points, then goal difference, then goals for, then name.
Returns `{"matches":[...]}` — every fixture in the season. Unplayed matches have `played:false` and omit the `score` object.
Returns `{"rows":[...]}` — each team's Monte Carlo championship probability (rates sum to 1). Returns 422 `PREDICTIONS_NOT_YET_AVAILABLE` until at least 4 weeks have been played.
Simulates every unplayed fixture in the next week and advances the season pointer. No request body. Returns `{"week":N,"matches":[...]}`. Returns 422 `SEASON_COMPLETE` once all weeks are played.
Simulates from the current week to the end of the season. No request body. Returns `{"weeks":[{"week":N,"matches":[...]}]}`. Returns 422 `SEASON_COMPLETE` if nothing remains.
Wipes results, resets the week counter to 0, and regenerates fixtures. No request body. Returns 204 No Content.

variable.description: ID of an already-played match to edit

request.description: Overrides the score of a played match. Standings and predictions recompute on the next read. Errors: 400 `VALIDATION` (bad id or body), 400 `INVALID_SCORE` (negative goals), 404 `NOT_FOUND` (no such match), 422 `MATCH_NOT_PLAYED` (match hasn't been played yet).
